integrity.evidence_basis: Standalone exact enumeration, complete acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and rational Lefschetz character computation; finite scope only.

scientific_limitations: Exact graph is the upward Hasse digraph on the 16 elements of the four-element Boolean lattice; other orientations are not classified.
The coordinate-permutation action is determined on rational homology; no equivariant sphere-wedge decomposition is asserted.
No calculation of higher Boolean-cube dimensions is claimed; bibliographic overlap with an unindexed exact matching-complex computation remains possible.
title: Integral multipath topology and coordinate-symmetry character of the oriented Boolean four-cube
